<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="darkGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#353843"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#181A20"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="10" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.18"/>

  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <circle cx="96" cy="108" r="112" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.14"/>
  <circle cx="328" cy="178" r="120" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.10"/>
  <circle cx="312" cy="700" r="156" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.10"/>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>

  <!-- Status Bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <rect x="305" y="17" width="17" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="323" y="20" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="307" y="19" width="11" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <line x1="350" y1="24" x2="350" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="356" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <line x1="370" y1="27" x2="384" y2="27" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  </g>

  <!-- Product Card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="100" width="346" height="130" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="34" y="112" width="106" height="106" rx="18" fill="#E7E7E7"/>
    <polygon points="48,184 64,160 77,174 87,158 112,184" fill="#C3C7CD"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="132" r="8" fill="#FFDD72"/>
    <text x="155" y="132" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#24262B">Modern Accent Chair</text>
    <text x="155" y="153" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Oak & boucle, dusk beige</text>
    <text x="155" y="177" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#24262B">$129.00</text>
    <text x="155" y="198" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">Delivered Jan 12, 2026 • Order #KH-48219</text>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="282" width="346" height="112" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="40" y="312" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#24262B">How would you rate this product?</text>
    <text x="40" y="334" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">Tap a star to rate from 1 to 5</text>
    <g transform="translate(38,350)">
      <polygon points="12,0 15.1,8.1 24,8.8 17.2,14.4 19.3,23 12,18.5 4.7,23 6.8,14.4 0,8.8 8.9,8.1" fill="#FFDD72"/>

      <text x="220" y="16" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">Great value</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Review Text Box -->
  <text x="22" y="430" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Your review</text>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="444" width="346" height="212" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="38" y="462" width="314" height="152" rx="16" fill="#F7F7F9" stroke="#E7E7E7"/>
    <text x="52" y="488" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#8E96A3">Tell others what you liked, what could be better, and</text>
    <text x="52" y="509" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#8E96A3">how the product fits in your space.</text>
    <text x="52" y="538" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#24262B">The chair feels sturdier than I expected and the fabric</text>
    <text x="52" y="559" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#24262B">matches the photos perfectly. Assembly took about 15</text>
    <text x="52" y="580" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#24262B">minutes and the finish looks premium in daylight.</text>
    <text x="52" y="612" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">283 / 500 characters</text>
    <rect x="286" y="616" width="46" height="18" rx="9" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <text x="309" y="629" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Save</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="670" width="108" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="22" y="670" width="108" height="42" rx="21" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.35"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="691" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="686" x2="42" y2="696" stroke="#6EA95C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="37" y1="691" x2="47" y2="691" stroke="#6EA95C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="58" y="695" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Add photo</text>

    <rect x="138" y="670" width="96" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="138" y="670" width="96" height="42" rx="21" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.35"/>
    <text x="186" y="695" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Delivery</text>

    <rect x="242" y="670" width="126" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="242" y="670" width="126" height="42" rx="21" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.35"/>
    <text x="305" y="695" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Assembly easy</text>

    <rect x="22" y="726" width="166" height="74" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="748" r="12" fill="#A06AF9"/>

    <text x="62" y="746" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#24262B">Lena M.</text>
    <text x="62" y="762" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">“Fast shipping, nice texture.”</text>
    <g transform="translate(62,770)">

    <circle cx="224" cy="748" r="12" fill="#FF968E"/>
    <text x="224" y="752" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">AR</text>
    <text x="242" y="746" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#24262B">Aiden R.</text>
    <text x="242" y="762" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">“Looks exactly like the listing.”</text>
    <g transform="translate(242,770)">
      <polygon points="0,0 1.6,4.1 6,4.4 2.7,7 3.6,11 0,8.8 -3.6,11 -2.7,7 -6,4.4 -1.6,4.1" fill="#FFDD72"/>
      <polygon points="10,0 11.6,4.1 16,4.4 12.7,7 13.6,11 10,8.8 6.4,11 7.3,7 4,4.4 8.4,4.1" fill="#FFDD72"/>

  </g>

    <rect x="22" y="796" width="346" height="40" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <text x="195" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Submit Review</text>

    <g transform="translate(246,784)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="15" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <circle cx="18" cy="15" r="2.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <line x1="18" y1="3" x2="18" y2="7" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="18" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Write</text>
